articles.titleCn: 开放式权重模型能在金融文本理解上竞争吗？
articles.abstractCn: 来自中国人工智能实验室的开权语言模型在近几个月内相对于专有前沿模型在基准测试中取得了追赶。然而，它们在现实世界金融任务上的可靠性仍基本未经测试。我们更新了金融触石基准，现在包含495份国际年度报告中的2,967个问题上下文-答案三元组。我们还对基准应用了一套新模型，将覆盖范围从十一扩展到二十个模型，涵盖十个供应商，包括最近的开权模型如GLM 4.7、GLM 5、Kimi K2.6和DeepSeek V3.2，以及阿里巴巴的专有旗舰Qwen3-Max。Anthropic的Claude Opus 4.6达到了最高准确率（88.4%），而谷歌的Gemini 2.5 Pro保持最低幻觉率（0.08%）。值得注意的是，开权的Kimi K2.6在准确率上排名第三，而非推理模型GLM 5和Mistral 3分别排名第四和第五，挑战了推理架构或专有权重是强金融理解力的先决条件的假设。信息检索仍然是主要瓶颈，占所有失败的48.9%。我们还记录了一个新发现：中国模型中的地缘政治内容过滤器拒绝合法金融问题（占尝试的0.08%），有时没有明确理由，拒绝行为与访问途径和模型一样重要。完整数据集和评估框架公开可用。

articles.title: Position Encoding in Transformers: From Absolute and Relative Methods to Rotary Position Embeddings and Long-Context Scaling
articles.abstract: Self-attention models content-dependent interactions between tokens but does not by itself encode token order. Position encoding addresses this limitation by introducing absolute coordinates, relative distances, or position-dependent rotations into Transformer representations and attention scores. This technical survey develops a unified account of sinusoidal and learned absolute position embeddings, Shaw-style relative position representations, Transformer-XL, T5 relative position bias, ALiBi, and Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE). We derive how RoPE converts absolute position indices into relative phase differences in Query-Key inner products and compare these methods in terms of where position is injected, computational cost, compatibility with KV caching, and length extrapolation. We then examine long-context extensions, including Position Interpolation, RoPE scaling laws, NTK-aware scaling, Dynamic NTK, NTK-by-parts, YaRN, LongRoPE, and LongRoPE2, with emphasis on frequency allocation, attention rescaling, training length, and target context length. We also summarize implementation considerations, evaluation protocols, and position-encoding choices in representative large language models. A central conclusion is that the ability to compute positional features beyond the training length does not imply reliable long-context generalization; context extension must be evaluated through short-context retention, position-wise perplexity, retrieval, reasoning, and long-context code tasks.
articles.comment: 14 pages, a cookbook for students and junior researchers
articles.titleCn: Transformer中的位置编码：从绝对和相对方法到旋转位置编码和长上下文缩放
articles.abstractCn: 自注意力模型能够捕捉标记之间的内容相关交互，但本身并不编码标记的顺序。位置编码通过将绝对坐标、相对距离或位置相关的旋转引入Transformer表示和注意力分数中，解决了这一局限性。本技术综述对正弦绝对位置嵌入、Shaw风格的相对位置表示、Transformer-XL、T5相对位置偏差、ALiBi和旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）等进行了统一阐述。我们推导了RoPE如何将绝对位置索引转换为查询-键内积中的相对相位差，并比较了这些方法在位置注入方式、计算成本、与KV缓存的兼容性以及长度外推方面的差异。随后，我们考察了长上下文扩展，包括位置插值、RoPE缩放规律、NTK感知缩放、动态NTK、NTK分段、YaRN、LongRoPE和LongRoPE2，重点分析了频率分配、注意力重缩放、训练长度和目标上下文长度。此外，我们还总结了代表性大型语言模型中的实现考虑、评估协议和位置编码选择。一个核心结论是，能够计算超出训练长度的位置特征并不意味着可靠的长期上下文泛化能力；上下文扩展必须通过短上下文保留、位置级困惑度、检索、推理和长期上下文代码任务进行评估。

articles.title: RAG-Based Auto-Configuration for Industrial Fieldbus Devices
articles.abstract: Industrial device commissioning requires engineers to manually extract hundreds of protocol-specific parameters from heterogeneous PDF manuals and transcribe them into supervisory control systems, a time-intensive, error-prone workflow. This paper presents SysName, a production-oriented pipeline that automates device configuration end-to-end for Modbus RTU, OPC-UA, Profibus DP, and CANopen. It builds a hybrid dense-sparse retrieval index augmented by an ontology graph derived from ECLASS, AAS, and SOSA/SSN, using a BGE-M3 encoder with a cross-encoder reranker to surface relevant manual passages. A local LLM (T=0.1) generates ontology-aligned JSON-LD configurations via protocol-specific prompts and a four-step repair pipeline. A two-stage abstention gate, combining a reranker-score threshold and an IRI resolution ratio, blocks unsafe LLM invocations and filters low-coverage configurations before SHACL validation. On a gold set of 28 field-level queries, the hybrid retriever reaches 0.96 HitRate@10, and the reranker raises MRR@10 from 0.56 to 0.63 with perfect score separation for abstention. The generator attains field-level F1=0.87 with exact match on 9 of 12 runs. End-to-end runs on an H100 GPU complete in 2.6-6.6s per device with zero unsafe writes and zero silent failures on a five-device benchmark; every unsuccessful run is flagged by abstention or deployment verification. Component-wise evaluation localises the single systematic failure to OPC-UA generation, invisible to end-to-end metrics alone. A case study commissions a physics-simulated Universal Robots UR5e robot from unmodified vendor documentation (254-page manual, 8-page register list, 496 chunks), reaching field-level F1=1.0 over three runs with read-back and joint-consistency verification. An ablation study and comparison with five industrial-LLM systems complete the analysis.
articles.titleCn: 基于RAG的工业现场总线设备自动配置
articles.abstractCn: 工业设备调试需要工程师手动从异构PDF手册中提取数百个协议特定参数，并将其转录到监控控制系统中，这是一个耗时且易出错的流程。本文介绍了SysName，一个面向生产的流水线，可端到端自动化配置Modbus RTU、OPC-UA、Profibus DP和CANopen设备。它构建了一个混合密集-稀疏检索索引，该索引通过从ECLASS、AAS和SOSA/SSN推导出的本体图进行增强，使用BGE-M3编码器和跨编码器重排序器来提取相关的手册段落。本地LLM（T=0.1）通过协议特定提示和四步修复流水线生成本体对齐的JSON-LD配置。一个两阶段拒绝门，结合重排序器分数阈值和IRI解析率，在SHACL验证之前阻止不安全的LLM调用并过滤低覆盖率配置。在一个包含28个现场级查询的金标准集中，混合检索器达到0.96的HitRate@10，重排序器将MRR@10从0.56提高到0.63，并实现了拒绝的完美分数分离。生成器在12次运行中有9次达到0.87的现场级F1值，并实现完全匹配。在H100 GPU上的端到端运行，每个设备完成时间为2.6-6.6秒，在五设备基准测试中无不安全写入和无声故障；每次不成功的运行都通过拒绝或部署验证被标记。组件级评估将单个系统性故障定位到OPC-UA生成，这是仅通过端到端指标无法发现的。一个案例研究从未修改的供应商文档（254页手册、8页寄存器列表、496个片段）中调试一个物理模拟的Universal Robots UR5e机器人，在三次运行中达到1.0的现场级F1值，并经过读回和关节一致性验证。消融研究和与五个工业LLM系统的比较完成了分析。

articles.title: North Africa's Missing Framework: NLP-Driven Mental Healthcare in Algeria and Implications for Low-resource Settings
articles.abstract: Mental health disorders are a leading cause of disability worldwide, yet Natural Language Processing (NLP) research for mental healthcare has remained concentrated in high-income, English-language settings. North Africa, and Algeria in particular, is largely absent from this literature despite its unique linguistic, historical, and healthcare context. We present the first conceptual framework examining the potential role of NLP within Algeria's mental healthcare system. Drawing on narrative synthesis of global NLP mental health research, Algerian healthcare literature, and low-resource NLP methodologies, we identify four structural barriers to mental healthcare: the language-of-care gap, geographic inequities in access, stigma-related barriers to help-seeking, and the absence of research and digital infrastructure. We then map existing NLP capabilities to each barrier, outlining their potential applications, implementation constraints, and the technical, institutional, and governance requirements necessary for deployment. Based on this analysis, we propose a research and policy roadmap that prioritizes data resources, multilingual language technologies, evaluation frameworks, and regulatory capacity. Although grounded in the Algerian context, the framework addresses challenges common to many multilingual, low-resource, and post-colonial settings. This work provides a foundation for future research on culturally and linguistically appropriate NLP for mental healthcare and offers a practical roadmap for developing responsible AI-enabled mental health systems in underrepresented regions.
articles.titleCn: 北非的缺失框架：阿尔及利亚基于自然语言处理的心理医疗保健及其对资源匮乏环境的启示
articles.abstractCn: 心理健康障碍是全球主要的致残原因，然而自然语言处理（NLP）在心理健康医疗领域的研究长期集中在高收入、英语国家。尽管北非地区，尤其是阿尔及利亚拥有独特的语言、历史和医疗保健背景，但该地区却几乎未被相关文献提及。我们提出了首个探讨NLP在阿尔及利亚心理健康医疗体系中潜在作用的概念框架。基于全球NLP心理健康研究的叙事综合、阿尔及利亚医疗文献以及低资源NLP方法，我们识别出心理健康医疗的四大结构性障碍：护理语言差距、地理获取不平等、寻求帮助相关的污名障碍以及研究和数字基础设施的缺失。随后，我们将现有的NLP能力与每项障碍进行映射，概述其潜在应用、实施限制以及部署所需的技术、制度和治理要求。基于此项分析，我们提出了一个优先考虑数据资源、多语言语言技术、评估框架和监管能力的研究与政策路线图。尽管该框架以阿尔及利亚背景为基础，但它也针对了许多多语言、低资源及前殖民地背景地区面临的共同挑战。这项工作为未来关于文化和语言适宜性NLP在心理健康医疗领域的研究奠定了基础，并为在代表性不足地区发展负责任的AI赋能心理健康系统提供了实用路线图。

articles.title: Mitigating Gender Bias in English to Romanian Machine Translation
articles.abstract: Machine translation (MT) systems often fail to correctly translate gender, especially when converting from a gender-neutral language like English to a gendered target language such as Romanian. This bias results in translations that default to masculine forms or reinforce gender stereotypes. We propose a hybrid pipeline to mitigate this issue by combining large language model (LLM)-based gender classification with neural machine translation (NMT). Our system uses a fine-tuned LLM to detect the intended gender of target words in English sentences and insert inline gender hint tags. These tagged sentences are then passed to a Transformer model fine-tuned to generate morphologically correct Romanian translations. To support this, we introduce three novel datasets for gender disambiguation and translation. Our approach improves gender accuracy on the WinoMT and WinoGender benchmarks by over 40 percentage points compared to a baseline MT system. This is the first method to explicitly address and evaluate gender bias in English-Romanian MT using both LLM inference and tag-aware translation.
articles.titleCn: 缓解英语到罗马尼亚机器翻译中的性别偏见
articles.abstractCn: 机器翻译（MT）系统常常无法正确翻译性别，尤其是在从英语等性别中立语言翻译到罗马尼亚等性别化目标语言时。这种偏见导致翻译默认采用阳性形式或强化性别刻板印象。我们提出了一种混合流程来缓解这一问题，通过结合基于大型语言模型（LLM）的性别分类与神经机器翻译（NMT）。我们的系统使用经过微调的LLM来检测英语句子中目标词的意图性别，并插入内联性别提示标签。这些带标签的句子随后被传递给一个经过微调以生成形态正确罗马尼亚翻译的Transformer模型。为此，我们引入了三个用于性别消歧和翻译的新数据集。与基线MT系统相比，我们的方法在WinoMT和WinoGender基准测试上的性别准确率提高了40个百分点以上。这是首个同时使用LLM推理和标签感知翻译来明确处理和评估英语-罗马尼亚MT中性别偏见的方法。

articles.title: OpenVisTool: An Open Recipe for Synthesizing Instructive Visual Tool-Use Trajectories
articles.abstract: Visual tool use has emerged as a fundamental capability for multimodal agents to actively acquire evidence beyond a fixed image encoding. The prevailing recipe learns this capability from teacher-generated trajectories filtered for answer correctness, implicitly assuming that every successful demonstration provides effective supervision. We argue this assumption is flawed: a strong teacher often reaches the correct answer without needing its tool calls, and imitating such trajectories teaches a student that tool calls accompany correct answers, not that tool observations ground them. We present OpenVisTool, an open framework for constructing instructive visual tool-use trajectories that provide effective supervision for tool learning. The key insight is that a trajectory should be retained only if its answer is correct (outcome validity) and its tool observations causally contribute to that answer (causal utility). The framework operates in three stages: difficulty screening to select queries that are not reliably answerable without tools, domain-specific trajectory synthesis to elicit coherent tool-use trajectories, and supervision verification to jointly test both conditions. Rather than encouraging models to imitate tool calls, the resulting supervision teaches when and how visual evidence should be acquired. Using this framework, we construct OpenVisTool-42K, a dataset spanning five visual reasoning domains, together with OpenVisTool-Bench, a benchmark covering the same domains. Across four backbones (4B-27B), fine-tuning on OpenVisTool-42K consistently improves visual tool-use performance and yields gains on two out-of-distribution benchmarks; the larger models approach leading closed-source systems. The evidence suggests that effective visual tool use is learned from causally grounded supervision rather than tool-calling patterns.
articles.titleCn: OpenVisTool：一个合成指导性视觉工具使用轨迹的开源配方
articles.abstractCn: 视觉工具使用已成为多模态智能体主动获取固定图像编码之外证据的基本能力。当前主流方法从教师生成的、经过答案正确性筛选的轨迹中学习这种能力，隐含假设每次成功的演示都提供有效的监督。我们认为这一假设存在缺陷：强大的教师往往无需工具调用即可得出正确答案，模仿此类轨迹会让学生认为工具调用伴随正确答案，而非工具观察支撑正确答案。我们提出了OpenVisTool，一个用于构建具有指导性视觉工具使用轨迹的开源框架，为工具学习提供有效监督。核心思想是：只有当轨迹答案正确（结果有效性）且工具观察因果贡献于该答案（因果效用）时，才应保留该轨迹。该框架分为三个阶段：难度筛选以选择无法可靠无工具回答的查询，领域特定轨迹合成以引出连贯的工具使用轨迹，以及监督验证以联合测试两个条件。该框架产生的监督并非鼓励模型模仿工具调用，而是教导何时以及如何获取视觉证据。基于此框架，我们构建了OpenVisTool-42K数据集，涵盖五个视觉推理领域，以及OpenVisTool-Bench基准，覆盖相同领域。在四个主干网络（4B-27B）上，在OpenVisTool-42K上进行微调可始终提升视觉工具使用性能，并在两个分布外基准上取得增益；较大模型已接近闭源系统。证据表明，有效的视觉工具使用是从因果支撑的监督中学习，而非工具调用模式。

articles.title: Reproducing and Stress-Testing Two Approaches to LLM Reasoning Reliability: Test-Time Probability Aggregation and Logic-Representation Editing
articles.abstract: We independently reproduce two recent methods for making large language model (LLM) reasoning more reliable, and stress-test them across domains and models (RPC across four new task domains with Qwen3-8B, LCF across four 7-8B models). The first, RPC, aggregates token probabilities and self-consistency at inference; the second, LCF, trains projectors that split hidden states into "content" and "logic" and edits the logic part toward a valid region. Validating such reliability claims matters because the original evaluations are run by each method's own authors and were never independently reproduced or stress-tested across models and domains, and LCF shipped no public code. We re-run RPC's published-path aggregation and re-implement LCF's projector, contrastive, and intervention pipeline, then extend both to text-to-SQL, legal extraction, fallacy identification, and precedent grading, and probe LCF's representation directly. RPC reproduces the original grid exactly on the authors' released reasoning paths; on four new domains its edge over self-consistency is never significant (ties or small mixed differences, paired p >= 0.28), and on BIRD, the one domain where we vary the budget, the edge grows with K as predicted but its largest gap (+2.5 accuracy at K=32, p=0.16) reverses to -0.25 when we enlarge the sample to n=200. LCF's logic-validity direction is real but weak (0.82 separability at the single best sub-layer versus 0.95 for a semantic-attribute control); its one positive effect (Qwen3 $Δ$Prob) is not significant (p=0.56), while it significantly reduces $Δ$Prob on two of the other three models.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Code, data, and experiment logs: https://github.com/rabqatab/llm-reasoning-reliability-reproduction
articles.titleCn: 复制和压力测试两种LLM推理可靠性方法：测试时概率聚合和逻辑表示编辑
articles.abstractCn: 我们独立地复现了两种近期用于提升大型语言模型（LLM）推理可靠性的方法，并在不同领域和模型上进行了压力测试（RPC在四个新任务领域使用Qwen3-8B进行测试，LCF在四个7-8B模型上进行测试）。第一种方法RPC通过聚合推理时的token概率和自洽性来提升可靠性；第二种方法LCF通过训练投影器将隐藏状态分割为“内容”和“逻辑”，并对逻辑部分进行编辑使其进入有效区域。验证这些可靠性声明至关重要，因为原始评估是由各方法的原作者进行的，从未被独立复现或跨模型和领域进行压力测试，且LCF未公开代码。我们重新运行了RPC的已发布路径聚合，重新实现了LCF的投影器、对比和干预流程，并将两者扩展到文本到SQL、法律提取、谬误识别和先例评分，并直接探测LCF的表征。RPC在原作者发布的推理路径上精确复现了原始网格；在四个新领域上，其相对于自洽性的优势从未显著（平局或微小混合差异，配对p ≥ 0.28），在BIRD这一我们改变预算的领域，优势随着K值的增加而按预期增长，但其最大差距（K=32时+2.5的准确度，p=0.16）在我们将样本扩大到n=200时逆转为-0.25。LCF的逻辑有效性方向是真实的但较弱（在最佳子层上的分离度为0.82，而语义属性控制的分离度为0.95）；其唯一正面效果（Qwen3的ΔProb）不显著（p=0.56），而在其他三个模型中的两个上显著降低了ΔProb。

articles.title: From Speech to Interaction: Analyzing Multimodal Systems in Cocktail-Party Scenarios
articles.abstract: Humans have the remarkable ability to engage in spontaneous informal conversations and selectively attend to individual speakers while filtering out competing speech from nearby conversations. This "cocktail party" scenario still presents severe challenges to speech recognition systems. The CHiME-9 MCoRec task provides a testbed where systems must recognize groups of speakers and transcribe each of their conversations from audio-visual input. In this work, we analyze a diverse set of systems, representing different design directions for addressing the cocktail-party scenario, where the best system achieves up to 57% relative error reduction. We identify three main strategies: (1) explicit or implicit audio-visual target speech separation, (2) improved audio-visual speech recognition for each target speaker, and (3) the use of large language models to group speakers into conversations and enhance conversational consistency. Our analysis shows that these directions address complementary failure modes of the cocktail-party problem, and that high speech overlap alone does not explain performance differences, challenging the common assumption that overlap is the primary source of difficulty in cocktail-party recognition.
articles.titleCn: 从语音到交互：分析鸡尾酒会场景中的多模态系统
articles.abstractCn: 人类拥有在嘈杂环境中进行自发非正式交谈，同时选择性地关注个别说话者并过滤掉附近其他对话中竞争性语音的显著能力。这种“鸡尾酒会”场景仍然给语音识别系统带来严峻挑战。CHiME-9 MCoRec任务提供了一个测试平台，要求系统从视听输入中识别说话人群体，并转录每个人的对话内容。在这项工作中，我们分析了代表不同设计方向以应对鸡尾酒会场景的一组多样化系统，其中最佳系统实现了高达57%的相对误差减少。我们确定了三种主要策略：(1)显式或隐式的视听目标语音分离，(2)针对每个目标说话者的视听语音识别改进，以及(3)使用大型语言模型将说话人分组到对话中并增强对话一致性。我们的分析表明，这些方向针对鸡尾酒会问题的互补性失效模式，并且仅高语音重叠并不能解释性能差异，挑战了重叠是鸡尾酒会识别中主要困难来源的普遍假设。

articles.title: Understanding Calibration and Truncation Error Propagation in Training-Free Low-Rank Compression for LLMs
articles.abstract: Training-free low-rank compression frameworks have been gaining prominence for LLM compression given their effectiveness in reducing model parameter count while maintaining task-level accuracy. However, existing SOTA frameworks share two key limitations: (1) residual errors in calibration data activations accumulate across layers during compression, causing misalignment between representations simulated at compression time and those experienced at inference; (2) the assumption that layer importance distribution is preserved post-compression does not hold. Together, these two effects introduce misalignment in the compression process in relation to the deployed model. We study these effects and propose a simple, training-free methodology compatible with existing frameworks to mitigate them, comprising: (1) Layer-by-Layer Compression with Calibration Correction; (2) Iterative Compression with Rank Allocation Correction. Implemented atop an existing SOTA decomposition framework, and evaluated on Llama and Qwen3 models across various benchmarks and compression rates, our approach demonstrates up to ~1-2.5 accuracy point improvements over per-weight and joint decomposition baselines on zero-shot tasks.
articles.titleCn: 理解无训练低秩压缩中LLMs的校准和截断误差传播
articles.abstractCn: 无训练的低秩压缩框架在LLM压缩领域日益受到关注，因其能有效减少模型参数数量同时保持任务级精度。然而，现有SOTA框架存在两大关键局限：(1) 校准数据激活中的残差误差在压缩过程中逐层累积，导致压缩时模拟的表征与推理时实际经历的表征之间出现错位；(2) 压缩后层重要性分布保持不变的假设并不成立。这两大效应共同导致压缩过程与部署模型之间产生错位。我们研究了这些效应，并提出了一种简单、无训练的方法论，可与现有框架兼容以缓解这些问题，具体包括：(1) 基于校准校正的逐层压缩；(2) 基于秩分配校正的迭代压缩。该方法建立在现有SOTA分解框架之上，并在Llama和Qwen3模型上针对不同基准和压缩率进行评估。结果表明，在零样本任务中，相较于逐权重和联合分解基线，我们的方法在精度上提升了高达~1-2.5个准确度点。

articles.title: MathShikkha: A Controlled Study of Answer-Only and Chain-of-Thought Supervision for Bangla Mathematical Reasoning in Small Language Models
articles.abstract: Mathematical reasoning remains challenging in low-resource languages such as Bangla. We study whether teacher-generated Bangla Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision provides benefits beyond ordinary supervised fine-tuning. We construct \textsc{MathShikkha}, a Bangla mathematical reasoning dataset with GPT-5.4-generated rationales, and fine-tune four 4B--7B student models under a matched protocol in which answer-only and CoT conditions share data splits, response-only loss masking, decoding, and scoring, differing only in the training target. In-domain, CoT provides no significant improvement over answer-only fine-tuning for three stronger backbones (paired bootstrap 95\% CIs include zero; exact McNemar $p \geq 0.17$), despite generating 15--52$\times$ more tokens, but significantly improves the weaker 4B model by 18.56 points ($p < 0.0001$). On the larger, contamination-audited BanglaMATH benchmark, this pattern reverses: CoT significantly outperforms answer-only supervision for all four models by 20.1--28.1 points (all $p < 0.0001$). Answer-only fine-tuning also reduces out-of-domain accuracy below the base model for three models, whereas CoT preserves or improves it for all four. A human study with two co-author annotators, external-expert adjudication, and Cohen's $κ= 0.76$--$1.00$ finds no significant CoT improvement over the base model on reasoning-content criteria; instead, its measurable effect is target-language adherence and producing inspectable reasoning. Overall, rationale supervision's value depends on backbone capability and distribution shift: in this setting, its main benefits are Bangla adherence, auditable reasoning, and out-of-domain robustness rather than improved in-domain reasoning validity.
articles.titleCn: MathShikkha：针对小语言模型中孟加拉数学推理的仅答案与思维链监督的受控研究
articles.abstractCn: 数学推理在孟加拉语等低资源语言中仍然具有挑战性。我们研究了教师生成的孟加拉语思维链（CoT）监督是否能在常规监督微调之外提供额外的好处。我们构建了带有GPT-5.4生成的推理的MathShikkha，孟加拉语数学推理数据集，并在匹配协议下微调了四个4B--7B的学生模型，该协议中，答案仅和CoT条件共享数据分割、响应仅损失掩码、解码和评分，仅在训练目标上有所不同。在领域内，尽管CoT生成了15--52倍的更多token，但对于三个更强的主干模型，CoT并未在答案仅微调上提供显著改进（配对自举95%置信区间包含零；精确McNemar p ≥ 0.17），但显著提升了4B模型的18.56分（p < 0.0001）。在更大的、经过污染审核的BanglaMATH基准测试上，这种模式发生了逆转：CoT在所有四个模型上显著优于答案仅监督，提升了20.1--28.1分（所有p < 0.0001）。而答案仅微调也使三个模型的领域外准确率低于基础模型，而CoT则保持了或提升了所有四个模型的领域外准确率。一项由两位共同作者标注者、外部专家裁决、Cohen's κ= 0.76--1.00的人类研究发现在推理内容标准上，CoT并未显著优于基础模型；相反，其可测量的效果是目标语言的遵循和生成可检查的推理。总体而言，推理监督的价值取决于主干能力与分布偏移：在此设置中，其主要好处是孟加拉语遵循性、可审核的推理和领域外鲁棒性，而非改进领域内推理的有效性。

articles.title: HoloAegis: Frozen Representation, Topological Inference: Minimally Parametric Safety Manifolds for Zero-Shot LLM Guardrails
articles.abstract: Current LLM safety guardrails face a fundamental tension: fine-tuning distorts pre-trained representations while generative judges incur prohibitive inference costs. We challenge the prevailing paradigm by asking: can safety be achieved through pure geometric reasoning over frozen semantic representations? We present HoloAegis, a minimally parametric topological inference framework that decouples representation from reasoning. We term our approach minimally parametric because the only free parameters are the anchor count K and the temperature tau, both fixed after construction and requiring no gradient-based training. An un-fine-tuned encoder maps text to a unit sphere, after which all decisions are purely geometric. We formalize safety evaluation as a Gibbs-Boltzmann Free Energy computation over a pre-computed System Topology Anchor Bank, and we introduce Dual Time-Scale Exponential Moving Averages to detect progressive multi-turn semantic drift. Our key theoretical insight is a Topological Boundary Stability Conjecture: we provide theoretical motivation and strong empirical evidence that sparse anchor centroids stabilize the decision boundary against high-frequency lexical perturbations far better than full vector space methods. Evaluated across 8 benchmarks, HoloAegis achieves state-of-the-art accuracy (1.0000 AUC on AuthenHallu, 0.9802 on HarmBench) with sub-millisecond latency, zero cold-start data, and cross-lingual transfer (0.9758 AUC on Chinese CHIFRAUD).
articles.titleCn: HoloAegis：冻结表征，拓扑推理：用于零样本LLM护栏的最小参数安全流形
articles.abstractCn: 当前的LLM安全防护措施面临一个根本性的矛盾：微调会扭曲预训练的表征，而生成式判别则会带来高昂的推理成本。我们通过提出一个问题来挑战主流范式：是否可以通过对冻结的语义表征进行纯粹的几何推理来实现安全？我们提出了HoloAegis，一个参数极少的拓扑推理框架，将表征与推理解耦。我们称这种方法为参数极少，因为唯一自由参数是锚点数量K和温度τ，它们在构建后固定，无需基于梯度的训练。未微调的编码器将文本映射到单位球面，之后所有决策都纯粹基于几何。我们将安全评估形式化为对预先计算的系统拓扑锚点库进行吉布斯-玻尔兹曼自由能计算，并引入双时间尺度指数移动平均来检测渐进的多轮语义漂移。我们的关键理论洞见是拓扑边界稳定性猜想：我们提供了理论依据和强有力的实证证据，证明稀疏锚点质心比完整向量空间方法更能有效地稳定决策边界，抵御高频词汇扰动。在8个基准测试中的评估表明，HoloAegis实现了最先进的准确率（在AuthenHallu上达到1.0000 AUC，在HarmBench上达到0.9802），具有亚毫秒级延迟、零冷启动数据以及跨语言迁移能力（在中文CHIFRAUD上达到0.9758 AUC）。

articles.title: VectraYX-Vision-1B: A Sub-2B Spanish/LATAM Cybersecurity Vision-Language Model with Structured Visual Reasoning and Native Tool Use
articles.abstract: We present VectraYX-Vision-1B, a sub-2B vision-language model (VLM) for Spanish/LATAM cybersecurity imagery, coupling a frozen SigLIP-so400m encoder to a 1.04B Spanish/LATAM security decoder via an MLP. To our knowledge, it is the first sub-2B VLM specialized for cyber UI (IDA, Ghidra, Wireshark, Nmap, Metasploit, Volatility) that answers in Spanish, emits structured reasoning via native <|think|> tokens, invokes tools via Model Context Protocol (<|tool_call|>), and exports to llama.cpp's LLaVA mmproj format for air-gapped deployment. We report a negative preliminary visual-grounding result: despite fully functional pipelines, the current vision SFT (400-1900 steps, ~16M tokens) yields near-zero B6 scores (0.08 tool-identification), ignoring image content. We specify remediation (longer SFT, >=60% replay, lower LR) and expose a checkpoint-loader bug (unstripped llm. prefix) masquerading as training collapse. Crucially, we introduce a 3-variant ablation matrix (V0: NoPE-every-4, V1: all-RoPE, V2: NoPE+learned 2D) to study if periodic no-positional-encoding (NoPE) layers help or hurt attention over the 729-token visual block. Code, configs, and weights are released to establish priority on this architectural question. We provide B1-B5 for the text backbone, text controls, preliminary B6/B7 scores, wall times, GGUF efficiency on CPU, and a corpus of 14,596 QA pairs across 10 domains. We open-source all models and trajectories: jsantillana/vectrayx-1b, jsantillana/vectrayx-vision-1b, and jsantillana/vectrayx-vision-1b-checks.
articles.titleCn: VectraYX-Vision-1B：一个拥有结构化视觉推理和原生工具使用的西班牙语/拉丁美洲网络安全愿景语言模型，参数规模小于2B
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了VectraYX-Vision-1B，一个针对西班牙语/拉丁美洲网络安全图像的亚2B视觉语言模型（VLM），该模型将冻结的SigLIP-so400m编码器通过一个MLP与一个1.04B西班牙语/拉丁美洲安全解码器耦合。据我们所知，这是第一个专门用于网络用户界面（IDA、Ghidra、Wireshark、Nmap、Metasploit、Volatility）的亚2B VLM，它用西班牙语回答问题，通过原生<|think|>标记发出结构化推理，通过模型上下文协议<|tool_call|>调用工具，并导出到 llama.cpp 的 LLaVA mmproj 格式以用于离线部署。我们报告了一个负面的初步视觉定位结果：尽管管道完全可用，当前的视觉SFT（400-1900步，约1600万标记）产生的B6分数接近零（0.08工具识别），忽略了图像内容。我们指定了补救措施（更长的SFT，大于等于60%的重放，更低的LR），并暴露了一个检查点加载器错误（未剥离llm.前缀），该错误伪装成训练崩溃。关键地，我们引入了一个3变体的消融矩阵（V0：每4个NoPE，V1：所有RoPE，V2：NoPE+学习2D），以研究周期性无位置编码（NoPE）层是否有助于或损害729标记视觉块上的注意力。代码、配置和权重已发布，以确立对这个架构问题的优先权。我们提供了文本主干、文本控制的B1-B5，初步的B6/B7分数、墙时间、CPU上的GGUF效率，以及跨越10个领域的14,596个问答对的语料库。我们开源了所有模型和轨迹：jsantillana/vectrayx-1b、jsantillana/vectrayx-vision-1b 和 jsantillana/vectrayx-vision-1b-checks。

articles.title: LLM within MCP Matters: Measuring Inefficient Resource Utilization Driven by LLMs
articles.abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes how servers expose data and tools to Large Language Models (LLMs). A common server design embeds frequently used reference data, such as identifier lookup tables, directly in the server instructions: the system-prompt text a server hands to the host application. When a query concerns an entry of the embedded table, the model can act on it immediately instead of re-discovering the same information through a search tool. We test whether client LLMs actually consume such instruction-embedded data, reporting a 54,000-trial study across 24 LLMs (9 Claude, 6 Gemini, 9 GPT) on a production legal-information MCP server. A diagnostic condition that removes the competing search tool shows that failures are dominated by behavioral preference rather than missing capability. With search unavailable, 23 of 24 models read the embedded data reliably (hit ratio at least 98%); with a search tool merely present, 9 models drop below 15%. A 2^3 factorial analysis of three instruction-level interventions reveals strong interaction effects: combining all three restores at least 86% for 20 of 24 models, but individual interventions can backfire for specific model families. Per-server prompt engineering is therefore a workaround rather than a fix; we argue that MCP host applications should provide an explicit mechanism that places server instructions ahead of tool selection in the client LLM's deliberation.
articles.comment: 4 pages, 1 table. Accepted at the AgentSearch Workshop at SIGIR 2026, Melbourne, Australia (non-archival). Code and data: https://github.com/rabqatab/llm-in-mcp-matters
articles.titleCn: LLM在MCP中的重要性：衡量由LLM驱动的低效资源利用
articles.abstractCn: 模型上下文协议（MCP）标准化了服务器如何向大型语言模型（LLM）暴露数据和工具。常见的服务器设计将频繁使用的参考数据（如标识符查找表）直接嵌入服务器指令中：即服务器提供给主机应用程序的系统提示文本。当查询涉及嵌入表中的条目时，模型可以立即对其采取行动，而不是通过搜索工具重新发现相同信息。我们测试客户端LLM是否确实消耗此类指令嵌入数据，并在生产环境中的法律信息MCP服务器上对24个LLM（9个Claude、6个Gemini、9个GPT）进行了54,000次试验的研究。一个移除竞争搜索工具的诊断条件表明，失败主要是由行为偏好而非能力缺失所致。在搜索不可用时，24个模型中有23个可靠地读取了嵌入数据（命中率至少98%）；而在仅提供搜索工具时，9个模型的命中率降至15%以下。对三个指令级干预措施的2^3因子分析揭示了强烈的交互效应：结合所有三项干预措施可至少恢复24个模型中的20个的86%以上，但单独干预措施可能对特定模型系列产生反效果。因此，针对单个服务器的提示工程是一种变通方法而非根本解决方案；我们主张MCP主机应用程序应提供一个明确机制，使服务器指令在客户端LLM的决策过程中优先于工具选择。

articles.title: Beyond Tables: Doc2DB-Bench for Relationally Faithful Document-to-Database Construction
articles.abstract: Practical AI systems increasingly need to turn long, heterogeneous documents into queryable relational databases, not isolated spreadsheets. In domains such as finance, healthcare, education, transportation, and enterprise operations, downstream workflows rely on normalized schemas, entity identities, keys, cross-table relationships, and integrity constraints for analytics, compliance, auditing, and SQL-backed decision making. Existing Document-to-Table benchmarks are insufficient for this setting: flattening evidence into single tables can duplicate entities, obscure many-to-many relationships, create sparse records, and avoid testing whether extracted facts form a valid database instance. This creates an urgent need to evaluate document understanding as database construction rather than field extraction. We introduce Doc2DB-Bench, a benchmark for Document-to-Database construction, containing 203 long-document instances across 42 schemas and seven domain groups, with 117 entity tables, 132 relationship tables, 7,341 rows, and 41,935 cells. Built through a controllable DB-to-Doc synthesis pipeline and organized by a taxonomy of intra-table extraction and inter-table reasoning, the generated documents undergo authenticity verification, proving indistinguishable from real-world references. Doc2DB-Bench thus provides a testbed for reliable, auditable, and relationally faithful LLM-based data systems. The benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/SetonLiang/Doc2DB-Bench.
articles.titleCn: 超越表格：Doc2DB-Bench用于关系忠实的文档到数据库构建
articles.abstractCn: 实用AI系统越来越需要将长篇异构文档转化为可查询的关系型数据库，而非孤立的电子表格。在金融、医疗、教育、交通和企业运营等领域，下游工作流依赖于规范化模式、实体身份、键、跨表关系和完整性约束，以进行数据分析、合规性检查、审计以及基于SQL的决策。现有的文档到表格基准在此场景下不足：将证据扁平化为单表可能导致实体重复、掩盖多对多关系、产生稀疏记录，且无法测试提取的事实是否构成有效的数据库实例。这迫切需要将文档理解评估为数据库构建而非字段提取。我们引入Doc2DB-Bench，一个用于文档到数据库构建的基准，包含42种模式、七个领域组中的203个长文档实例，涵盖117个实体表、132个关系表、7,341行和41,935个单元格。通过可控的数据库到文档合成流程构建，并按表格内提取和表格间推理的分类组织，生成的文档经过真实性验证，证明其与真实世界参考无法区分。Doc2DB-Bench因此为可靠、可审计且关系忠实于LLM数据系统提供了测试平台。该基准已公开发布于https://github.com/SetonLiang/Doc2DB-Bench。

articles.title: Calling the Bluff: Detecting Ever-Shifting Harmful Chat Dialogue via Ordered Reasoning Chain Regularization
articles.abstract: Harmful chat dialogues are ever-shifting through type-shifting and lexical evasion, yet we find they share invariant principles, i.e., an Ordered Reasoning Chain (ORC) of recurring topics, harm language indicators, severity hierarchies, and type characteristics, which can help us capture the key information in the frequently changing lexical expressions. We propose BRACE, which encodes the ORC as four differentiable stages (Topic -> Indicator -> Severity -> Type) with intermediate supervision, serving as a structured regularizer blended with direct heads, and supported by prototype-based feature augmentation and feature path disentanglement. The evaluation results show that, across 4 domains and 5 harm categories, BRACE achieves harm-type macro F1 of 0.934 (RoBERTa-wwm-ext, 3-seed mean), with decoder backbones (Qwen3-1.7B LoRA) reaching 0.949. Ablation studies show that all components contribute to BRACE, and the structural decomposition of ORC enables BRACE to distinguish harmful types with semantic ambiguity. Disclaimer: This paper may contain content that is disturbing to some readers.
articles.titleCn: 揭穿谎言：通过有序推理链正则化检测不断变化的有害聊天对话
articles.abstractCn: 有害的聊天对话通过类型转换和词汇规避不断变化，但我们发现它们遵循不变的原则，即一个有序推理链（ORC），包含反复出现的主题、危害语言指标、严重程度等级和类型特征，这有助于我们在频繁变化的词汇表达中捕捉关键信息。我们提出了BRACE模型，将ORC编码为四个可微分的阶段（主题→指标→严重程度→类型），并辅以中间监督，作为结合直接头的结构化正则化器，同时通过原型特征增强和特征路径解耦进行支持。评估结果表明，在4个领域和5个危害类别中，BRACE实现了危害类型宏观F1值0.934（RoBERTa-wwm-ext，3种子均值），解码器主干（Qwen3-1.7B LoRA）达到0.949。消融研究表明，所有组件都对BRACE有贡献，ORC的结构分解使BRACE能够区分具有语义模糊性的危害类型。免责声明：本文可能包含令部分读者感到不适的内容。

articles.title: Hidden Language Consistency Phenomena in Reasoning LLMs
articles.abstract: Multilingual reasoning models are commonly evaluated by whether they arrive at the correct answer, but not by whether they preserve the intended language while reasoning and responding. This omission conceals important multilingual behaviors that emerge as tasks become harder. In this paper, we study task difficulty, task accuracy, thinking-language consistency (TC), and answer-language consistency (AC) across reasoning models using PolyMath benchmark in eight languages and four difficulty levels. We uncover four findings: (1) language consistency exhibits four difficulty-dependent behaviors: output-language consistency remains aligned with input, remains misaligned, degrades gradually, or collapses abruptly. (2) We identify the language consistency breakdown effect, where increasing difficulty can cause a sudden drop in output-language consistency, especially in less strongly represented and non-Latin-script languages. (3) Due to this breakdown effect, accuracy can be preserved or even improved at a harder difficulty level as the model shifts to its internal dominant language. (4) Quantization can improve or degrade output-language consistency independently of its effect on accuracy, with GPTQ and AWQ often outperforming AutoRound under tolerance-based voting with ε = 1.0. These results show that multilingual capability cannot be characterized by accuracy alone; reliable evaluation should jointly consider task accuracy, language consistency, and task difficulty for multilingual benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 推理大型语言模型中的隐藏语言一致性现象
articles.abstractCn: 多语言推理模型通常通过其是否得出正确答案来评估，而非通过其在推理和回应时是否保持预期语言。这种遗漏掩盖了随着任务难度增加而出现的重要多语言行为。在本文中，我们使用PolyMath基准，在八种语言和四个难度级别下，研究了推理模型中的任务难度、任务准确率、思维-语言一致性（TC）和答案-语言一致性（AC）。我们发现了四点： (1) 语言一致性表现出四种与难度相关的行为：输出语言一致性保持与输入一致、保持错位、逐渐退化或突然崩溃。 (2) 我们识别出语言一致性崩溃效应，即增加难度会导致输出语言一致性突然下降，尤其是在代表性较弱和非拉丁字母语言中。 (3) 由于这种崩溃效应，随着模型转向其内部主导语言，准确率可以在更高难度级别下保持甚至提高。 (4) 量化可以独立于其对准确率的影响来改善或恶化输出语言一致性，GPTQ和AWQ在基于容差的投票（ε = 1.0）下通常优于AutoRound。这些结果表明，多语言能力不能仅通过准确率来表征；可靠的评估应综合考虑任务准确率、语言一致性和任务难度，用于多语言基准。

articles.title: CAP: A Scalable Benchmark for Evaluating Cross-Site Browser Agents with Complex Actions and Perception
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents that interact with the web through browsers. While recent progress has been driven by benchmarks that evaluate end-to-end task success, these evaluations largely overlook two fundamental sources of difficulty in real web browsing: complex actions over rich user interfaces and visual perception of dynamically rendered content, especially in workflows that span multiple websites. We introduce CAP, a scalable benchmark for evaluating browser agents on cross-site, human-like web tasks that require non-trivial UI interactions and visual understanding. Specifically, we adopt a decomposition-and-recomposition pipeline that first abstracts each website into a structured site card capturing user-facing functions, complex execution operations, and perceptual requirements, and then recomposes these components into realistic cross-site workflows. Each task is therefore grounded in multiple specific operations on each website, enabling fine-grained diagnosis. Built on this framework, we construct 420 tasks across 108 real-world websites and 24 domains under careful quality control. Experiments on state-of-the-art browser agents using our verifiable agent-as-a-judge evaluation framework show low success rates and reveal that perception-heavy interactions remain a major bottleneck, exposing substantial gaps between current agents and real-world web browsing demands.
articles.titleCn: CAP：一个用于评估具有复杂动作和感知的跨站浏览器代理的可扩展基准
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被部署为通过浏览器自主交互的智能体。尽管最近的进展是由评估端到端任务成功率的基准所推动的，但这些评估在很大程度上忽略了真实网络浏览中的两个基本难点：复杂操作与丰富的用户界面交互，以及动态渲染内容的视觉感知，尤其是在跨越多个网站的工作流程中。我们引入了CAP，一个可扩展的基准，用于评估在需要非平凡UI交互和视觉理解的人类般跨站网络任务上的浏览器智能体。具体而言，我们采用了一种分解与重组的流程，首先将每个网站抽象为一张结构化的站点卡片，捕捉面向用户的功能、复杂的执行操作和感知需求，然后将这些组件重组为真实的跨站工作流程。因此，每个任务都基于每个网站上的多个具体操作，从而实现细粒度的诊断。基于这一框架，我们在严格的质量控制下，在108个真实世界网站和24个领域构建了420个任务。使用我们可验证的智能体作为裁判的评估框架对最先进的浏览器智能体进行的实验表明，成功率较低，并揭示感知密集型交互仍然是主要的瓶颈，暴露了当前智能体与现实世界网络浏览需求之间的巨大差距。

articles.title: Safety Cost of Steering Vectors Is Separable and Reducible
articles.abstract: Steering vectors are a lightweight tool for controlling LLM behavior. However, emerging evidence shows that steering vectors can unintentionally compromise a model's safety mechanisms and increase compliance with harmful requests, while no effective mitigation yet exists. In this work, we show that this safety degradation arises from a separable component in the vector that disrupts the model's safety mechanisms but contributes little to the steering objective. We identify and remove this safety-degrading component, formulating the task as a constrained optimization problem solved through primal-dual updates, subject to preserving the intended steering effect and bounding false refusal. The resulting solution is both interpretable and surgical: the optimization recovers a single direction whose ablation from the steering vector restores model safety with minimal utility cost. Across models, steering behaviors, and attack suites, including unseen attacks types, our method substantially reduces steering-induced safety degradation while preserving the original steering effect with minimal impact on false refusal. Our method offers a post-hoc correction to steering vectors that mitigates their safety cost, and more broadly, it provides a general recipe for applying activation-level model interventions without paying a safety tax.
articles.titleCn: 转向矢量安全成本是可分离和可降低的
articles.abstractCn: 导向向量是控制大型语言模型行为的轻量级工具。然而，越来越多的证据表明，导向向量可能无意中损害模型的安全机制，并增加对有害请求的遵从性，而目前尚无有效的缓解措施。在这项工作中，我们表明这种安全性能下降源于向量中的一个可分离分量，该分量会破坏模型的安全机制，但对导向目标贡献甚微。我们识别并移除了这个损害安全性能的分量，将任务表述为一个约束优化问题，通过原始-对偶更新求解，同时确保保持预期的导向效果并限制错误拒绝。所得解决方案既具有可解释性又具有精确性：优化过程恢复了一个单一方向，将其从导向向量中移除后，可最小化效用成本地恢复模型安全。在我们的方法中，针对不同的模型、导向行为和攻击套件，包括未见过的攻击类型，该方法显著降低了导向引起的性能下降，同时几乎不影响错误拒绝，并保留了原始的导向效果。我们的方法为导向向量提供了一种后处理校正手段，以减轻其安全成本，更广泛地说，它提供了一种通用的方法，用于在不付出安全代价的情况下应用激活级别的模型干预。
